about.title: A field guide, not another neon arcade
about.p1: PlayTrail is an independent, curated discovery site for browser games. We walk the catalog of browser games the way a trail guide walks a mountain range: slowly, taking notes, and pointing you to the real thing. Games themselves run on external platforms — chiefly CrazyGames — and one click from a game’s page takes you there.
about.p2: Every listing is written by a human editor: an original one-line summary, an original description, and only facts we can verify. Where something is unverified — controls, device support — the page says so instead of guessing. Sources and the date each entry was verified are shown on every game page.
about.p3: Games are organized into a fixed set of main categories, plus free-form gameplay tags. Featured placements on the home page are editorial choices; the hot snapshot is a labeled capture of an external chart, with its collection time and region attached.
about.p4: PlayTrail has no confirmed official affiliation with CrazyGames and is not the official site of any platform. Game content, ads and availability are provided by the external platform. We don’t host games, sell placements, or accept payment for listings.
about.p5: Corrections and feedback are welcome through the channels on the copyright page.

privacy.title: What we collect, and what we don’t
privacy.p1: PlayTrail works without accounts, without cookies, and without cross-site tracking. This page describes the few things that are measured and how long they are kept.
privacy.p2: When you browse a game page or click a link to an external platform, the site may record one of three events: a game-page view, an outbound click, or a related-games click. Each event contains a random event id, the event type, which game, which page type, the page path, the interface language, a timestamp, and the in-site context of the click (for example, whether you arrived from the home page or from a related-games card). No account, device identifier, IP address, full referrer URL, or search terms are attached.
privacy.p3: These counts are used only in aggregate (for example, a click-through rate per game) and are retained for a limited period: raw events are deleted after 30 days, daily aggregates after 90 days.
privacy.p4: The site sets no cookies for visitors. To understand whether you came from the home page, a category, or a related card, a single temporary value may be kept in your browser’s sessionStorage during the current tab session and is deleted as soon as it is read. It is not persisted and not shared.
privacy.h2Respect: Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control
privacy.p5: If your browser sends a Do Not Track signal or the Global Privacy Control signal, PlayTrail stops sending product events entirely. Pages and outbound links keep working normally.
privacy.p6: The hosting infrastructure keeps standard server logs, which may include IP addresses, for security and abuse prevention. Logs are kept for at most 30 days and are not combined with product events.
privacy.p7: If you have questions about this policy, use the contact channel on the copyright page.

copyright.title: Corrections, takedowns and ownership
copyright.p1: PlayTrail catalogs games that run on external platforms. We write our own summaries, generate our own cover artwork for games without licensed images, and never republish third-party descriptions, screenshots or artwork.
copyright.p2: If a fact on a game page is wrong — the developer, controls, device support, or the link itself — tell us and we will verify and fix it. Report broken links too: a game whose external page has disappeared is switched to “link unavailable” rather than silently removed.
copyright.p3: If you own a game listed here and want the listing changed or removed, or if you believe an image or text on this site infringes your rights, contact us with the game name, the page address, and a short description of the issue. We respond to every request.
copyright.p4: Game names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used here for identification only. PlayTrail is not affiliated with CrazyGames; CrazyGames is a trademark of its respective owner.
copyright.contactPending: The concrete contact channel (email or form) is provided by the site owner and will be published here before launch. No placeholder address is shown on purpose.
